newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's ABA to start Internet study.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's ABA to start Internet study.

text.p: Australian Broadcasting Authority (ABA) said on Tuesday it had been invited by UNESCO (the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation (UNESCO)) to start a study on regulatory issues about the Internet.

"The ABA has consistently taken the view that international cooperation is one of the best ways to tackle the implications of the global phenomenon that is the Internet," ABA board member Tim O'Keefe said in a statement.
The pilot study would identify some of the main features of the on-line environment, particularly as they related to content of on-line services, O'Keefe said.

O'Keefe said the study would also look at recent technical developments such as Platform for Content Selection (PICS) and the emergence of labelling schemes and consider areas which might benefit from international cooperation.
He said the pilot study, due to be completed in March, would also consider the cost and feasibility of a larger comparative study which could be conducted by the ABA later in 1997.
